current_help_recovery_note: When the social layer is ambiguous, stale, or contradictory, the route points back to the current official page, reviewed FAQ/help entry, or named office contact instead of treating audience interaction as controlling.
delivery_role_note: The service reviews platform-native interaction surfaces around already-open official media so comments, live chat, Q&A, polls, and reactions remain subordinate to the full recording plus the current official page/help lane rather than quietly becoming a shadow help desk or correction lane.
elevated_interaction_boundary_note: Pinned comments, Top Chat, approved Q&A items, featured comments, and reaction counts are treated as elevated conversation fragments rather than automatic official instructions.
replay_and_portability_note: Chat replay, direct comment links, copied comments, and exported interaction artifacts are treated as context-limited conversation fragments rather than authoritative stand-alone records.

reviewed_social_layer_contexts.context_note: Reviewed whether the official watch page exposes comments and whether pinned or highlighted comments can look like controlling updates.
Reviewed whether live chat exists during the event, whether chat replay survives afterward, and whether replay fragments stay visibly subordinate to the recording plus the current written lane.
Reviewed whether the event page exposes Q&A, poll, like, or reaction modules and whether those interaction tools can be mistaken for official guidance or official endorsement.
Reviewed whether comments or chats can be linked, copied, downloaded, or exported in ways that detach them from surrounding context.

social_layer_provenance_note: The service distinguishes platform-managed interaction surfaces from office-reviewed notices, FAQs, or corrections even when both appear beside the same recording.
social_layer_surface_label: Example comments, live-chat, Q&A, poll, and reaction posture for official voter-information media routes
